description: SANOU ELECTRICITE: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SANOU ELECTRICITE. Coverage: SANOU ELECTRICITE. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Borne de recharge sur parking privé ouvert au public (la conciergerie); Borne de recharge parking privée ouvert au publique; Borne de recharge sur parking ouvert au public (IXINA LE CRES); Borne de recharge sur parking privé ouvert au public (Prodici). Formats seen: CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
